deadline.value: Central scholarship rounds: the international Round 1 (31 August) for starts by end of March 2027 has already closed. The next is Round 2, closing 15 April 2027 (year inferred) for starts by 31 August 2027; it is typically a smaller round. Admission applications are open all year.
deadline.quote: The application deadline to be considered in Round 1 (commencement of study in following year) is 31 August. The application deadline to be considered in Round 2 (commencement of study in same year) is 15 April.

also.quote: Round 2 has a deadline of 15 April and is typically a smaller round with commencement or take up of the scholarship up to the end of August of the same year.

supervisor.value: A supervisor in the ANU School of Computing must be available and willing to supervise you, and you need an identified research project before applying.
supervisor.quote: There must be a supervisor within the ANU School of Computing who is available and willing to supervise your research, and you must have identified a research project.

funding.value: Stipend scholarships are allocated competitively through the central rounds (you are considered automatically). The RTP stipend is AUD 40,475 a year (2027 base rate). International tuition is AUD 58,925.00 a year (indicative).
funding.quote: HDR living stipend scholarships are allocated following a competitive process.

entry_route.value: A relevant four-year undergraduate degree (honours level, H2A or above; first-class often required) or a postgraduate degree with a significant research thesis.

notes: Four-year full-time PhD (academic plan 9714XPHD). HDR clusters include Intelligent Systems and Data Science (no separate data-science PhD). The school suggests a self-assessment test before the pre-application.
